items.briefing:
Australian education platform Mathspace has suffered a data breach affecting over one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information has been exposed, making this directly relevant to schools and training organisations across the country — including registered training organisations that may use or recommend the platform. If your organisation or its learners use Mathspace, treat any related communications with caution and monitor for follow-up phishing attempts targeting affected users.

Separately, AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing and harder to detect, with experts warning that AI makes social engineering more effective than ever. Be sceptical of unexpected messages, even if they seem personal or urgent.

**Tip:** If you or a student received a Mathspace account notification recently, verify it directly through the official website — don't click links in emails.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
